mapper.select: SELECT strategy_case.strategy_case_id, strategy_case.retry_parent_case_id, strategy_case.case_code, strategy_case.case_name, strategy_case.request_payload_json, strategy_case.generation_stage, strategy_case.failure_code, strategy_case.failure_message, strategy_case.completed_at, strategy_case.created_by AS requester_id, requester.user_name AS requester_name, sku.sku_id, sku.sku_code, sku.sku_name, source_point.sales_point_id AS source_sales_point_id, source_point.sales_point_name AS source_sales_point_name FROM strategy_case strategy_case JOIN sku ON sku.sku_id = strategy_case.sku_id LEFT JOIN app_user requester ON requester.user_id = strategy_case.created_by LEFT JOIN sales_point source_point ON source_point.sales_point_id = strategy_case.requested_sales_point_id WHERE strategy_case.strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND strategy_case.case_status = 'GENERATION_FAILED' AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0
